name: Retrieve a specific data tag category template.
description: Retrieve a specific data tag category template. Gets an available data tag category template. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_tag_category_templates/{template_id}

name: Retrieve all data tag category templates in an account
description: Retrieve all data tag category templates in an account Lists available data tag category templates. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_tag_category_templates
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_tag_category_templates
Lists available data tag category templates.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Fetch limits associated with DLP for account
description: Fetch limits associated with DLP for account Retrieves current DLP usage limits and quotas for the account, including maximum allowed counts and current usage for custom entries, dataset cells, and document fingerprints. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/limits
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/limits
Retrieves current DLP usage limits and quotas for the account, including maximum allowed counts and current usage for custom entries, dataset cells, and document fingerprints.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Validate a DLP regex pattern
description: Validate a DLP regex pattern Validates whether this pattern is a valid regular expression. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/patterns/validate
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/patterns/validate
Validates whether this pattern is a valid regular expression. Rejects it if the regular expression is too complex or can match an unbounded-length string. The regex will be rejected if it uses `*` or `+`. Bound the maximum number of characters that can be matched using a range, e.g. `{1,100}`.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body) — Validation query.

name: Get payload log settings
description: Get payload log settings Gets the current payload logging configuration for DLP, showing whether matched content is being logged. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/payload_log
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/payload_log
Gets the current payload logging configuration for DLP, showing whether matched content is being logged.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Set payload log settings
description: Set payload log settings Enables or disables payload logging for DLP matches. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/payload_log
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/payload_log
Enables or disables payload logging for DLP matches. When enabled, matched content is stored for review.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — New payload log settings.
